description: This file defines dependencies and route handlers for a FastAPI application, demonstrating use of dependency injection with query parameters and cookies.

methods.name: query_extractor(q: str | None = None)
methods.description: Extracts a query parameter 'q' from the request, returning None if not provided.

methods.name: query_or_cookie_extractor( q: str = Depends(query_extractor), last_query: str | None = Cookie(default=None) )
methods.description: Uses dependency injection to get 'q' via query_extractor and 'last_query' from cookies; returns 'q' if present, otherwise 'last_query'.

methods.name: read_query(query_or_default: str = Depends(query_or_cookie_extractor))
methods.description: API endpoint that returns the value from dependencies, either a query parameter or cookie.

ctags.name: query_or_cookie_extractor
ctags.signature: ( q: str = Depends(query_extractor), last_query: str | None = Cookie(default=None) )
